## ST_DISTANCE with use_spheroid
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
# The distance over the WGS84 spheroid. BigQuery answered the values: the geodesic between the
# points where the geographies are closest over the sphere, so a point on a line is 1e-10 meters
# away, and 0 where a polygon contains the other geography.

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), TRUE)
=> "111319.49079327357"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 1), TRUE)
=> "110574.38855779878"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.4194, 37.7749), ST_GEOGPOINT(139.6917, 35.6895), TRUE)
=> "8289537.5826439755"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 90), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, -90), TRUE)
=> "2.0003931458625447E7"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 0), TRUE)
=> "2.0003931458625447E7"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(179.9, 0.1), TRUE)
=> "1.999208210791384E7"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(179.5, 0), TRUE)
=> "1.9980861908890963E7"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 20), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 20), TRUE)
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 10 10)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(9, 9), TRUE)
=> "155851.49814424562"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 0 60)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(1 0, 1 60)'), TRUE)
=> "55799.4703932604"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 10)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 5), TRUE)
=> "110898.66346004255"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 10)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 5), TRUE)
=> "8.819351806785948E-11"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 1, 10 2)'), TRUE)
=> "110574.38855779878"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), TRUE)
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(5 5, 6 7)'), TRUE)
=> "470253.7059663307"

# The closest point over the sphere, inside the edge, is meters away from the closest point over
# the spheroid, which BigQuery does not look for.

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 60)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(60, 20), TRUE)
=> "6065159.591378623"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 60)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(60, 20))
=> "6056647.296516174"

# BigQuery rejects the SAFE. prefix on ST_DISTANCE, with or without use_spheroid.

SELECT SAFE.ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0))
=> error: SAFE with function st_distance is not supported.

SELECT SAFE.ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), FALSE)
=> error: SAFE with function st_distance is not supported.

SELECT SAFE.ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), TRUE)
=> error: SAFE with function st_distance is not supported.
